channel.title: The Daily Herald of Everett, Washington - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Herald of Everett, Washington (heraldnet.com)

item.title: Silvertips playing motivated through final stretch
item.description: Everett displays dominance on near-nightly basis, gearing up for WHL playoffs next month.

item.title: Minor earthquake hits south Snohomish County
item.description: The magnitude 3.0 earthquake, which struck before 6 a.m. Tuesday, is just about the smallest quake people can feel.

item.title: Snohomish County judge rules Flock camera footage is public record
item.description: The ruling comes as state lawmakers debate a bill that would exempt automated license plate reader footage from the Public Records Act.

item.title: Everett mayor issues directive outlining ICE response
item.description: Among other actions, it prevents immigration agents from entering non-public city property without a warrant and directs Everett police to take action if they see excessive use of force.

item.title: Everett temporarily pauses Flock camera network
item.description: The city will deactivate its 68 cameras after a Snohomish County judge ruled that the footage is considered public record.

item.title: No injuries in second school bus collision this week
item.description: On Wednesday morning, fire and police crews responded to a collision involving a school bus carrying 28 students in Snohomish.

item.title: Editorial cartoons for Wednesday, Feb. 25
item.description: A sketchy look at the news of the day.

item.title: Snohomish boys basketball falls in 3A State opening round
item.description: The Panthers end landmark season with 69-62 loss to Mountain View at home on Tuesday.

item.title: Meadowdale girls basketball survives scrappy River Ridge
item.description: The Mavericks take down the Hawks 81-72 in the first round of the state tournament on Tuesday.

item.title: Vote for The Herald’s Prep Athlete of the Week for Feb. 15-21
item.description: The Athlete of the Week — individual state champions edition — nominees for Feb. 15-21. Voting closes at midnight Sunday. The winner will be announced with the next poll and in next Wednesday’s paper.
